title: 🚖 Airport Pickup & Ground Transfers
h1: Seamless Travel Experience for International Patients in India
intro: Arriving in a new country for medical treatment can be stressful. To ensure a safe, smooth, and worry-free journey, we provide airport pickup and ground transfer services for all our international patients. From the moment you land in India, our dedicated team takes care of you and your family, making sure you reach your hospital or accommodation comfortably.

sections.heading: 🚐 Our Transfer Services Include
points: Airport Pickup & Drop: Private cars or ambulances for safe travel
Hospital Transfers: Directly from airport to hospital admission desk
Hotel / Guesthouse Transfers: Drop-off at pre-booked accommodations
Ambulance Transfers: For patients requiring stretcher, oxygen, or medical care
City Transfers: Comfortable ground travel for consultations & follow-ups

sections.heading: 🩺 Why Patients Trust Our Ground Transfers
points: Meet-and-greet at airport arrival gate
Professional drivers trained for patient comfort
Options: Sedan, SUV, luxury cars, or ambulances
24/7 availability across major cities
Assistance with luggage & medical equipment
Stress-free travel for patients & family

sections.heading: 🌍 Special Support for International Patients
points: Multilingual assistance (Arabic, Russian, French, African languages)
Coordination with hospitals for direct admissions
Travel for wheelchair-bound or bed-bound patients
Affordable packages compared to regular taxi or private services

sections.heading: 💰 Cost of Transfers
points: Airport Pickup (Car): $25 – $50
Ambulance Transfer (Basic): $100 – $200
Ambulance Transfer (ICU-equipped): $250 – $500
Outstation Transfers: Based on distance & requirements
